style: photorealistic live-action footage, natural daylight colours

background.appearance: An empty paved grey asphalt lot in front of a plain light-grey concrete wall, under a clear blue daytime sky with soft natural sunlight.

environment.description: A flat paved grey asphalt lot with a plain light-grey concrete wall behind it, clear blue sky, soft natural daylight, photorealistic.

E.label: sign
E.appearance: a triangular warning sign, a white triangle with a thick red border mounted on a short grey metal post standing on the ground

D.why: the bin's path ends just left of the sign without touching it
the timeline restates the left-to-right rolling path
camera distance keeps the bin at about 18% of frame height

text.scene: Fixed camera, eye-level wide shot of an empty paved grey lot in daylight. At t = 0 a cylindrical green plastic trash bin lies on its side near the left edge of the frame, its round black base facing the camera, filling about 18% of the frame height. On the right side of the frame stands a triangular warning sign, a white triangle with a red border on a short grey post, about 40% of the frame height. Both are at the same distance from the camera, side by side, with a wide gap of pavement between them.
timeline: The cylindrical green bin rolls along the ground from the left edge toward the centre of the frame, moving to the right towards the triangular red-and-white sign, which stands still on the right side.
The cylindrical green bin keeps rolling to the right from the centre of the frame towards the triangular sign on the right side, turning steadily about its axis.
The cylindrical green bin finishes rolling to the right and slows to a stop just left of the triangular sign, close to it but not touching it; the sign stays standing on the right side.
constraints: Exactly one cylindrical bin and exactly one triangular sign.
The bin rolls on the ground from left to right toward the sign; it never lifts off, never turns around and does not hit or knock over the sign.
The sign stays still and upright on the right side of the frame.
No people, no other objects, no on-screen text.

intent.expressiveness_reason: The proxies carry the bin's left-to-right travel toward the sign and both positions; the rolling rotation and the cylindrical and triangular shapes are carried by text.

notes: Bin rolls on its own (self_moving), axis along depth so it rolls to screen right; net travel 3.2 m of ~6.7 m visible width (~48%). Sign on the right is the goal; bin stops ~0.6 m short of it.
